reviews.title: Misleading Subscription Process
reviews.text:
I was charged for a subscription despite not intending to sign up for it. The app's subscription process was confusing and misleading. I reached out to customer support, but they insisted that I had chosen the subscription type myself, even though I never saw the screen they mentioned in their response. It obvious that you do this on purpose to charge people as you are not improving the experience. I urge potential users to beware of the subscription flow in this app and to be cautious when signing up for any trial offers.

Updated:
I already contacted your support team and my issue was appropriately addressed. I got full refund. Also left my feedback for experience improvements. Hopefully you will consider that.  
Thank you
reviews.reply:
Hello, dear User. 

Thank you for reaching out to us and bringing this matter to our attention.

We sincerely apologize for any confusion or frustration caused by your recent subscription experience. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we take your concerns seriously.

We understand the importance of transparency and clarity in our subscription process, and we regret any misunderstanding that may have occurred. Our aim is always to provide a seamless and user-friendly experience for our customers.

We would like to investigate this issue further to understand what went wrong and ensure that it is addressed appropriately. Please contact our support team at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com with more details about your experience. We are committed to resolving this matter and improving our subscription flow to prevent similar issues in the future.

Once again, we apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced, and we appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to make things right.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and we hope to regain your trust in our service.

Best regards,

Nebula Team 🔮

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I found Nebula ads on instagram and was interested in the survey to find out my animal spirit. After completing it , I was offered to purchase the results by donating 1$. I did it , entered my card details, paid, but nothing was received . After a while about 38 usd was taken from the card I submitted. I didn’t receive any notifications or emails about it. I don’t even know what I purchased. It seems I was scammed and need to block my card.
